messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great! I've successfully added 2 GB of data to your line. The $4.00 charge has been added to your current bill.

Now, to ensure you get excellent internet speed while in France, let's check a few more settings on your device that might be affecting your data performance.

Could you please run the following diagnostic on your phone:

**check_data_restriction_status**

This will tell us if Data Saver mode is currently enabled, which could be restricting your data speeds.

The Data Saver mode on my phone is currently off, so it's not restricting my data speed. What should we check next to help me get excellent internet speed?

Please process the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
